column1: # Golden words: what a build has to show for particular words.
# `python -m medical_yomitan golden ARCHIVE` (and `validate`) checks every line and fails when one does not hold.
#   scope: xiandai-yixue-cidian, xinbian-shiyong-yixue-cidian, or empty for both dictionaries
#     present                 the headword is an entry of the dictionary
#     absent                  nothing is filed under this term: no entry and no spelling of one
#     reading VALUE           an entry of the headword has this reading
#     indexed VALUE           an entry of the headword is also filed under this term (an alternate MDX key)
#     traditional VALUE       the same check, for a traditional spelling
#     traditional_box S=TEXT  found by the term S, the entry shows TEXT in its traditional box
#                             (S is the headword itself or one of its spellings; nothing after =: no box)
# -- Traditional spellings are Taiwan's (s2tw), shown in the box and indexed
# -- ... and an entry is also found under the Hong Kong (s2hk) and OpenCC (s2t) spelling. Found that way it
#    shows the spelling after the Taiwan one; found by the headword or the Taiwan form it shows the Taiwan form only

column3: 裏急後重=裡急後重、裏急後重

column1: # -- A character restored from a private-use placeholder passes through as restored (OpenCC would write 噁 for 𫫇)
# -- Vocabulary is never swapped: these are what s2twp would have filed the entries under
# -- Forms OpenCC gets wrong are corrected (data/traditional_corrections.tsv): 症 is not 癥, a transliterated
#    范 or 里 keeps its character, 巨细胞 is not 鉅細胞, a surface is not flour, a clock is 鐘, dry is 乾.
#    The wrong form is not filed at all, also not as a lookup-only spelling
# -- A correction holds in all three standards: the lookup-only spelling of 着色性干皮病 is 着色性乾皮病, not 着色性幹皮病
